jobs.occupation: EMEA Sales Manager - Specialty Polymers & Elastomer Materials
jobs.description:
The role focuses on managing and developing relationships with large international customers across the industrial materials sector.

Jobomschrijving

As a Sales Manager your responsibilities are:

• Develop and execute sales strategies to achieve business objectives.
• Manage and grow key accounts, ensuring long-term relationships with clients.
• Identify market opportunities and devise plans to capitalise on them.
• Monitor sales performance and analyse data to improve results.
• Collaborate with internal teams to align sales strategies with company goals.
• Lead and motivate the sales team to achieve individual and collective targets.
• Prepare and present regular sales reports to senior management.
• Stay updated on retail market trends and competitor activities.

A successful Sales Manager should have:

• 10+ years of experience in sales and business development.
• Proven success managing international and global key accounts.
• Strong background in specialty materials, raw materials, polymers, plastics, compounding, or related industrial sectors.
• Experience within the TPE/TPC/SBC market is highly desirable.
• Demonstrated ability to develop business and grow strategic customer relationships.
• Strong commercial acumen, negotiation skills, and ability to close complex deals.
• Fluent English (written and verbal).
• Comfortable working within a multicultural and international environment.
• Highly autonomous, self-motivated, and capable of working independently.
• Willingness to travel extensively across the region.

The client is an international engineering and industrial project partner delivering modularized systems, skids, and integrated technical solutions for demanding industrial and data center environments.

Jobomschrijving

• Design and document LV/MV electrical systems, including single-line diagrams, cabling, cable routing, layouts, grounding, lighting, transformers, switchgear, busbars, UPS systems, emergency generators, electrical tracing, and other associated equipment.
• Develop and maintain electrical and instrumentation documentation, including equipment datasheets and specifications, cable schedules, material take-offs, I/O lists, loop diagrams, hook-up drawings, junction box documentation, communication cable lists, and functional analyses.
• Manage the instrumentation scope, including the selection and integration of pressure, temperature, level and flow instruments, analyzers, control valves, on/off valves, remote I/O, fire & gas detection systems, and related equipment.
• Coordinate technical interfaces with piping, mechanical, structural, automation, workshop, and procurement teams, ensuring that electrical and instrumentation designs are compatible with modular construction, assembly, testing, and site installation requirements.
• Support technical procurement and project execution by reviewing supplier quotations, leading technical clarification meetings, preparing technical bid comparisons, validating process data, supporting workshop configuration, and ensuring documentation, traceability, QA/QC, and applicable standards are respected.

• Industrial Engineer with a minimum of 5 years of experience in E&I engineering within an industrial environment such as oil & gas, pharmaceuticals, energy, manufacturing, or data centers.
• Strong technical expertise in electrical engineering and instrumentation, including LV/MV systems, industrial electrical equipment, instrumentation, cabling, control systems, and associated engineering documentation.
• Good knowledge of industrial communication protocols and control architectures, including HART, Modbus RTU, PROFIBUS, PROFINET, OPC UA, ESD systems, process control systems, and SIL principles in accordance with IEC 61508 and IEC 61511.
• Fluent in English and French

jobs.occupation: Bus Mechanic – good salary + training opportunies
jobs.description:
Do you enjoy working on vehicles and solving technical problems? In this role as a bus mechanic, you ensure that coaches are safe, reliable and ready for daily operations.

• You carry out maintenance and repairs on buses.

• You diagnose mechanical issues and fix them efficiently.

• You perform preventive maintenance to keep vehicles in top condition.

• You work on a varied fleet of different brands and models.

• You ensure every vehicle meets safety and quality standards.

• You have a background in mechanics (experience is a strong plus).

• You can work independently and take responsibility for your tasks.

• You are able to identify and solve technical problems.

• You are eager to learn and interested in new vehicle technologies (like electricity).

• You are open to following additional training.

• You speak Dutch or English.

• You are flexible with working hours while valuing a good work-life balance.

• A driving license D is a plus.

You will define and guide the technical architecture of a growing application ecosystem used in safety-critical operational processes. You will work closely with developers, analysts, product stakeholders and technical teams to ensure that new and existing solutions are scalable, reliable and future-proof.
You will use your expertise to assess current implementations, propose improvements and help shape upcoming developments. You will coach developers, promote best practices and ensure that architectural decisions are translated into clean, maintainable and robust solutions.
You will also proactively identify technical risks, challenge implementation choices where needed and ensure that quality, scope and deadlines remain aligned. Because the applications support real-time operational workflows, performance, stability and clear communication are crucial throughout your mission.

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in IT (or equivalent through strong experience)
• Senior professional experience with .NET
• Experience as Architect / Senior Analyst
• Knowledge of Angular
• You're a pragmatic team player
• You work in English and understand Dutch & French

As a Credit Controller, you will manage a portfolio of B2B debt collection files, ensuring timely payments while maintaining professional client relationships. You will coordinate with internal and external stakeholders, monitor legal procedures, and contribute to achieving collection targets in a structured and dynamic environment.

Client Details

Our client is a well-established and respected organization active in the automotive sector. They offer a collaborative environment, professional training opportunities, modern working practices, and a strong focus on employee development and work-life balance. 

Description

Key Responsibilities

• Manage and follow up on B2B collection files.
• Analyze outstanding debt cases and monitor recovery procedures.
• Contact customers via phone, email, and written correspondence regarding overdue payments.
• Send payment reminders and formal notices.
• Maintain and update administrative records and internal systems.
• Coordinate with external partners, legal representatives, bailiffs, and internal departments.
• Monitor accounting statuses and liaise with the finance team.
• Prepare tailored repayment proposals.
• Ensure proper follow-up of ongoing legal and collection procedures.
• Identify risks and suggest process improvements to management.
 

Profile We're Looking For

• 3+ years experience in credit collection and credit control
• Medior level professional with a structured way of working.
• Comfortable working in a B2B environment.
• Interest in legal procedures and debt recovery processes.
• Strong administrative and organizational skills.
• Good communication skills and confidence when dealing with customers.
• Proactive attitude and willingness to learn.
• Good command of French; Dutch or English is a strong advantage.
• Comfortable using different IT systems and tools.

As a Legal Secretary, you will provide high-quality administrative and organisational support to a team of lawyers, ensuring the smooth management of schedules, client communications, travel arrangements and legal documentation. You will also collaborate with internal teams across the Brussels and international offices.

 

Client Details

Our client is a leading international law firm with a strong reputation for excellence and a collaborative working environment. To support its Brussels office, the firm is looking for a highly organised and proactive Legal Secretary.

 

Description

As a Legal Secretary, you will provide comprehensive administrative support to a team of lawyers and contribute to the smooth running of the office. Your responsibilities will include:

• Agenda management, organisation of meetings en events.
• Coordinating travel arrangements.
• Handling calls, emails and correspondence.
• Preparing, formatting and proofreading legal documents, presentations, reports and correspondence.
• Supporting billing processes and expense reporting.
• Working closely with colleagues across the Brussels and international offices to ensure seamless support.

 

• You have at least 2 years of experience in an administrative, Legal Assistant, Management Assistant or Executive Assistant role.
• Experience within a legal or professional services environment is an asset.
• You are fluent in English, French is a plus
• You have excellent organisational skills and strong attention to detail.
• You can manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment while maintaining a high level of accuracy and professionalism.
• You are proactive, adaptable and able to work both independently and as part of a team.

jobs.occupation: Sales Associate - Chocolate Boutique - Bruges City Centre
jobs.description:

Do you want a job with real growth potential? Are you passionate about customer service and working with high-quality products?

Then this might be the perfect opportunity for you.

This renowned chocolate boutique, located in the historic centre of Bruges, specialises in premium Belgian chocolate and offers customers an authentic chocolate experience.

The shop is known for its wide selection of pralines, truffles, and other handcrafted chocolate delicacies, all made with passion and craftmanship.

• Experience in a production environment is a plus, but if you’re motivated and hands-on, we’ll get you up to speed.
• The working language in the company is English, so Dutch is not required.

jobs.occupation: KYC Analyst - Temp mission of 3 months - Brussels - M/F/X
jobs.description:
As a KYC Analyst you will play a key role in verifying and maintaining client information. This temporary role of 3 months requires a solid understanding of KYC processes and fluency in English.

Client Details

Our client is an international Fintech present in many countries around the world and having its HQ in Brussels.

Description

As a KYC Analyst your responsibilities are:

• Review and verify client documentation to ensure compliance with KYC requirements
• Maintain and update client records in line with regulatory standards
• Conduct due diligence on new and existing clients
• Identify and report any discrepancies or risks in client documentation
• Collaborate with internal teams to address compliance issues effectively
• Ensure timely and accurate completion of KYC processes
• Assist in audits and regulatory reviews as needed
• Stay updated on changes in KYC regulations and industry standards

A successful KYC Analyst should have:

• A first experience in KYC is necessary
• Fluency in English, both written and spoken. Please note that we are unable to sponsor work permits or visas. Therefore, applicants must already be legally authorized to work in Belgium at the time of application
• Strong attention to detail and organisational skills
• Knowledge of banking and financial services regulations

Are you ready for a challenging career in the FAB Engineering team? Would you like to work with the most high-tech devices? Then read on quickly!

As an Equipment Maintenance Engineer, you'll start your journey in the esteemed FAB Engineering team:

jobs.occupation: English-speaking CE truck driver - frozen food transport
jobs.description:
Are you an experienced CE Driver who's living in Belgium and looking for a stable job? Do you hold a valid CE driving licence and code 95? And do you want to work at a reliable transport company where you can drive modern trucks and be home most evenings?

For a leading frozen food transport and logistics company in Oostkamp, we're recruiting a CE truck driver for delivering frozen food products to customers throughout Belgium and its neighbouring countries. Dutch isn't required for this job, so you're free to apply if you only speak English!

Your job

As a CE truck driver, lorry driver, or HGV driver, you will ensure the safe and on-time delivery of frozen food products to supermarkets, distribution centres, and business customers.

Your drives:

• Transport of frozen goods
• National deliveries throughout Belgium, but also to the Netherlands, Luxembourg, France and Germany 
• Up to 15h/day on the road (waiting and resting times included)
• Varying number of stops: between 5 to 15 stops/day
Routes are prepared in advance and your trailer is already loaded, connected, fuelled, and ready to go before departure.

You'll almost never have to sleep in your truck, except for some for very exceptional cases when there's no other possibility.

We're looking for a driver who:

• Has a valid CE driving licence, code 95 and driver card

• Is residing in Belgium and has legal right to work in the country
• Has a good level of English
• Isn't afraid to start early in the morning and to tackle longer routes
• Has their own transport to the company (no public transport nearby   truck cannot be taken home)
Previous experience in frozen food transport, refrigerated transport or distribution transport is an advantage but not required.

 

!! IMPORTANT ELIGIBILITY REQUIREMENTS: please read carefully before applying !!

• You must already be living in Belgium
• You must already have a valid legal right to work in Belgium (EU citizenship or valid work permit)
Candidates who do not meet these requirements will not be considered for the position. We do not provide visa sponsorship, work permits, relocation support or immigration assistance.

You will be a member of our SEM/TEM team. This team is responsible for in-line and out-of-line released electron microscopy inspection.  As a TEM technician you ensure the smooth processing of the various TEM inspections, focusing on the quality of the inspection. 

As SEM/TEM technician you will have the following key responsibilities: 

• You follow-up the inline TEM queue.
• You adjust released recipes for automated TEM inspections.
• You are responsible for (semi)-automated and guided TEM inspections.
• You contribute to achieving targets.
• You help with statistical process control (SPC) on TEM tools. 

• Preferable you have a bachelor’s degree or associate degree (2-year program) in science (chemistry, biology, physics) or equal to experience.
• It would be a great plus if you have hands-on experience with automated metrology or SEM/TEM inspections in the semi-conductor industry.  
• You are a strong planner and you would enjoy working in a fast-paced environment. You certainly know how to multi-task and prioritize assignments.  
• You are a communicative team player with a very good knowledge of both English and Dutch.
• You are prepared to work in a shift system (early/late/night and 1 weekend out of 4).
